title: District AI Acceptable Use Policy (template)
derived_from: Texas DIR AI Acceptable Use Policy (see governance/texas/applicability-matrix.json TX-DIR-AUP)
notes: Template only. A district adopts, edits, and versions this; the adopted version id is bound to each AI system record through AISystemRecord.policy_version.
permitted_uses: Locating and summarising approved district policy, regulation, and procedure
Drafting routine administrative communication for human review before sending
Answering operational questions from approved district documentation
Assisting staff with IT self-service and documented troubleshooting steps
prohibited_uses: Making or materially influencing a student discipline decision without human review
Making or materially influencing a special education eligibility or placement decision
Making or materially influencing an admission, placement, hiring, or employment decision
Generating a student or staff risk score used to allocate services or scrutiny
Entering student personally identifiable information into an unapproved external AI tool
Using AI output as the sole basis for any consequential decision about a person

prohibited_inputs: student education records in unapproved tools
data_handling.approved_model_requirement: Models must be registered with approved_trust_domains covering the data they will receive, and must not permit vendor training on submitted data above PUBLIC classification.

required_for: any consequential decision about a student or employee
